conceptOrigin.author: Christopher Vardeman
conceptOrigin.sourceSummary: Segment binary information, repeatedly fold and stack the resulting layers, use a stage-ladder signal model, and pack or unpack limited deterministic binary through gated swing information.

normalizedInterpretation.pairTransform: anchor = first bit; swing = first bit XOR second bit
normalizedInterpretation.recursiveStep: Fold the anchor stream again while preserving each swing stream as a ladder level.
normalizedInterpretation.rawInformationConservation: One root bit plus all swing stages equals the original block bit count.
normalizedInterpretation.compressionMechanism: Select the cheapest reversible codec independently for each swing stage.
normalizedInterpretation.securityBoundary: PFL is a lossless transform and compressor, not encryption. Compression must precede any real encryption layer.

classification: Experimental lossless binary transform and compression research; no cryptographic security claim.
nextGate: Integrate validation into deployment and add a raw escape mode so incompressible blocks do not expand beyond bounded framing overhead.
